remarks: Charming 940 sq ft bungalow designed for comfort, style, and easy living—perfect for empty nesters or first-time buyers. Features 9' ceilings, vinyl plank flooring throughout, and a bright, functional layout.   The inviting foyer leads to an undeveloped basement and a front primary bedroom with large windows, a 3-piece ensuite with glass-enclosed shower, and a spacious walk-in closet.   The main floor also includes a laundry area and a full 3-piece bath with a glass shower. At the rear, enjoy an open-concept great room, dining nook, kitchen, and a second bedroom for added privacy. The great room is filled with natural light from expansive windows and a garden door to the backyard.   The kitchen offers a peninsula with flush eating ledge, Silgranit undermount sink, pendant lighting, built-in microwave, quartz counters, chimney-style hood fan, full-height tile backsplash, raised cabinet doors, and a large pantry. Brushed nickel fixtures and basement rough-in plumbing included. (id:67522)
courtesy: David Lam, Exp Realty and Joe Tolvay, Exp Realty
